content: Hello, this is Michelle from Amazon Customer Resolutions. Am I speaking with Ms. Sanders?
Yes, this is Janet Sanders. Sorry, there's a lot going on here, but what is this about?

No problem, Janet. I'll try to keep this brief for you. I'm reaching out regarding your recent order that has been held for further verification. I just need to confirm a few details to get things moving.
Oh, okay. I did wonder why it was delayed. What do you need from me?
Thank you for your cooperation. For your security, could you please verify your full shipping address and the phone number linked to your Amazon account?
Sure, it's 1835 Willow Lane, Millington, and the phone number is 402-555-0142.
Thank you, Janet. Now, the issue here is that your package is being held due to a new import regulation. All affected shipments require a refundable customs fee before they can be released.
A customs fee? That's never happened before. I don't have time for anything complicated.

I absolutely understand, Janet. This is a recent policy update, and I know it's inconvenient. The good news is that the fee is fully refundable after your delivery. I'll guide you through it step by step so it only takes a few minutes.
Alright, if that's what I need to do to get my package. How much is the fee?
The customs fee for your order is $85. Once we receive it, your package will be immediately cleared for delivery, and the amount will be credited back to your account within two business days.
Can you just charge my card on file or something? I don't have time to do paperwork.

Unfortunately, due to the nature of this regulatory fee, payment must be made through a secured method. For your convenience, Amazon currently processes these fees using Amazon Gift Cards or through the Zelle payment network.
Gift cards? That seems odd. Why can't I just use my normal payment method?

I completely understand your concern, Janet. The customs office only accepts payments through these channels to ensure quick processing and prevent unauthorized charges. It's a temporary solution until the new system is in place. Your cooperation is essential for immediate delivery.
Okay, so I need to buy an Amazon gift card for $85?
That's correct. You can purchase the gift card online or at any nearby store. Once you have the card, simply provide the code to me here so I can forward it to the customs processing team.
Alright, I think I have one from a birthday. Does it matter if it's new?
As long as the card has at least $85 on it and hasn't been redeemed, it will work perfectly. Please let me know once you have the code ready.
Can you wait while I check in the kitchen?
Of course, Janet. Please take your time. I'll stay on the line with you to make sure everything goes smoothly.
Alright, I found a $100 card. What do I do next?
Perfect. On the back of the card, you'll see a code. Please read it out to me so I can enter it in our secure portal.
Okay, it says X4T9-8G3P-5KLM-Q2ZN.
Thank you, Janet. Let me process that for you. While I do this, can you please confirm the email address linked to your Amazon account? This will ensure your refund is credited properly.
It's janet.sanders19@gmail.com.
Got it. Everything is moving forward now. Your package will be released for delivery and you'll receive a confirmation email shortly. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, just let me know if there are any more problems. Thank you for your help.
You're welcome, Janet. Thank you for your understanding and cooperation. If you have any questions, feel free to contact us. Have a great day.
